import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    term1 = p[0]*t**2/(1+p[1]*t**2)*np.exp(-p[2]*x**2)
    term2 = p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*x**2)*np.exp(-p[5]*v**2)
    term3 = p[6]*t**2*v**2
    term4 = p[7]*np.exp(-p[8]*t**2)*np.exp(-p[9]*x**2)
    return term1+term2+term3+term4
